peer_identity.arc_label: Sterile Emperor who fathered Janus-Jana and bestowed the Metabaron title on Othon
peer_identity.honcho_notes: Sterile; Janus-Jana produced after 30 years via scientific means. Expresses deep personal gratitude to Othon. Offers compassionate consolation ('another horse'). Rules jointly with the Empress. Grateful sovereign rather than commanding autocrat.
peer_identity.rationale: Split from the Aghora-era Emperor because generations separate them—different people hold the same title. The Othon-era Emperor is personally sterile (required hospital-planet conception of Janus-Jana), emotionally attached to Othon, bestowed the hereditary Metabaron title. The Aghora-era Emperor (vol16) is described as 'two-headed'—visually and biologically distinct. Contradictory TRAIT facts if merged.
